correctness.rationale: Constructed from scratch the 24 signed coordinate permutations of (0,1,2), edges at Euclidean squared distance 2: cubic graph with 36 edges. Enumerated the entire ordinary independence complex: 37075 nonempty faces, 219216 oriented Hasse incidences. Independently implemented greedy vertex-toggle discrete-Morse matching: 18535 nonempty pairs, one critical zero-cell and four critical five-cells with exact bitmasks 1575960,2149378,2441252,8603650. Full directed Hasse graph topological sort visited all 37075 cells, establishing genuine acyclicity and an integral wedge of four S^5. Independently enumerated all 56 induced six-edge matchings (12-vertex crosspolytope boundaries). Rebuilt all 64-term oriented fundamental cycles, 5083 matched 5/6 cancellation pairs, a complete acyclic elimination dependency graph, and exact Z^4 critical-face coordinates: all 56 have gcd one and nonzero class. Enumerated 48 signed coordinate graph automorphisms and support orbits of sizes 8,12,12,24. The unique size-8 orbit has determinant-one 4x4 minor on support indices (0,1,6,28); other three orbit matrices have rank exactly three and gcd of their 3x3 minors one, hence primitive rank-three sublattices. Independently recomputed all 48 reduced Lefschetz character traces over every face, obtaining multiplicities {-4:1,-2:6,-1:8,0:18,1:8,2:6,4:1}, and matched every trace with the central-inversion sign twist of sign(S4)+standard(S4). Since inversion is order two and its rank-4 trace is -4, it acts as -I integrally. The standard sharp flag-support lemma gives lower bound 2d+2=12 for any nonzero H5 on a minimal vertex-induced support, and equality forces a 6-crosspolytope boundary; combined with exhaustive 56-match census, this proves all shortest carriers. No finite field surrogate was used for integral primitivity.
residual_risks: The n=24 result does not classify all higher permutahedra or give an integral irreducible decomposition; the rational isotypic formula is not an integral direct sum.

value.rationale: A canonical finite, highly symmetric graph has known H5 rank 4, but abstract Betti numbers say nothing about the smallest induced subgraphs supporting cycles or how their orbit spans the integer lattice. The exact minimum-support 56-carrier census, a unique 8-class saturating orbit, and three primitive nonspanning orbits provide a structurally motivated integral geometry-of-generators classification. The explicit O_h character is a nontrivial invariant beyond the previously published vertex-local homotopy type. This self-contained finite fact is worthwhile without a higher-dimensional family theorem.
residual_risks: Scope is only the 24-vertex graph; no claim about all truncated or permutahedral graphs.

limitations: Flag min-support bound and exact n=24 graph model, no higher n extension
Exact integral coordinate and orbit computations were independently rebuilt, not inferred from the old 4-sphere result
No integral splitting of rational S4-representation claimed.
